title: Start
detail: Entry: moves on to state 1 (to state 11, the failure state, when the start fails).

evidence.note: case 0 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred

title: Decide: load a save or start new
detail: Asks the serializer for the request type (function 0x167ce0): when the result is 2 (inferred: a saved game is to be loaded) the next state is 4, otherwise 2.

evidence.note: case 1 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred

title: Configure Content
detail: Configure Content: the game content is configured and the asset load restarted; then state 3 (11 on failure).

evidence.note: case 2 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred

title: Set gameplay logging
detail: Reads the gameplay logging options (listed below), then goes to 6 (new game) or 7 (unserialize a game state): the value is (x != 0) + 6 for a pointer x read in this state (inferred: whether a saved game stream was loaded).

evidence.note: case 3 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred

title: Load a save file
detail: Loads the save file, then state 5 (11 on failure).

evidence.note: case 4 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred

title: Save load pending (apply mod state)
detail: Save load pending: when done the mod state is applied (`ApplyModdingState`) and the sequence continues with Configure Content (state 2); 11 on failure.

evidence.note: case 5 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred

title: New game
detail: Starts a new game (`InitializeNewGame`), records the `StartupGameTimings` numbers, goes to state 8; 11 on failure.

evidence.note: case 6 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred

title: Unserialize game state
detail: Unserializes the game state, initialises the cache, runs post-initialisation and records the timings; the successor state was not read out.

evidence.note: case 7 of the state switch in LoadGameViewState::LaunchNextStage (0x84870), decompiled; transition conditions are partly inferred
